posts.body_html: AG3 is notoriously hard to deal with. I provided the plant material which produced the vft King Henry to my buddy Don Elkins and on a number of occasions they "casually" forgot to send him his royalties. He had to jump thru hoops to get it into action. They also told him they were not interested in tc'ing taller growing Sarracenia...which is an outright lie because they tc'd Dana's Delight, leuco Tarnok and Bug Bat (blah). If they were on the up and up I would have submitted some of my plants for tc...but they're very shady!
